t: Sense About Science is a British charity that promotes public understanding of science and respect for sound evidence. It was founded in 2002 by Lord Taverne, Bridget Ogilvie and others, and became a charitable trust in 2003. Dick Taverne matters here as a founder. He was a Lincoln MP from 1962 to 1974, first for Labour and then, after resigning and winning the 1973 by-election, as a Democratic Labour candidate. Later he sat as a Liberal Democrat life peer. Tracey Brown has directed the organisation since the start.
